text_block_list.text:
Since Meisho Doto wasn't feeling well, I 
decided to have her rest in the 
infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll get plenty of rest and recover my 
strength... Ugh, good night~~~~......

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume Group
text_block_list.text: Bancho Doto, osu!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyowa?! B-B-Banchooo...!? ...Me, of all 
peopleee?!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Bancho Doto! That hairstyle looks super 
badass! You're completely fired up!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: P-P-Please stop calling me "Banchou"~~...!

...Oh! Calling yourself "the Boss" while 
brushing me aside— what unbelievable 
nerve!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-O-Opera O-san?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There can only be one leader fit for this 
"Torisen Academy"! I challenge you to a 
duel for the title of Bancho!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeeh!? Wh-What kind of dangerous 
invitation is that...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... I don't wanna duel you! Y-You can 
have the leader title, just take itttt...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...! To desire peace even in the midst 
of a brawl-ready bloodbath... What 
incredible kindness!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...I love that spirit! From this day on, 
we're soul buddies. Let's rule together as 
the 'Double Bancho'!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume Group
text_block_list.text: Uwooooooaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fwaaa~h!? ...W-What does that mean 
exactly...!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The two of us will take charge and make 
this an academy overflowing with smiles! 
Now, let us laugh together, Doto!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Mwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Hwah!? Th-This isn't what it looks 
like! I-I-It was a dream, um, well, you 
seeee...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: With O-Opera O-san... Ehehehe...

Did she have a good dream? Meisho Doto's 
slump seemed to have blown completely 
away!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's settle this with a 'Super 
Skillful! Dialogue Showdown'! Best 
regards, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"You're not coming back anymore! Never, 
never, never, never, never again!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... "You don't bring no peaches! 
Nitoto, nitotto, nitototo~~!?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! It's no goooood~! I can't say it 
at aaallll!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... I-I can't even get things right 
in my dreamsss~~............

It seems she had a bad dream. Meisho 
Doto's condition did not improve.
